blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sibol’s Karl Gonzalvo marched into the quarterfinals of the Puyo Puyo Champions of the Asian Games 2026 esports tournament after finishing third in Group A on Thursday at Aichi Sky Expo. Gonzalvo started off on the wrong foot, falling to the 11-year-old Japanese star Yuki Kurihara, 0-3, but he recovered in the succeeding games to finish with a 2-2 record and punch his ticket directly to the quarterfinals. The content creator-turned-national athlete bounced back with a narrow 3-2 win over Yu Wing Lim of Hong Kong before cruising to a 3-0 victory over Alexandr Pivovarov of Kazakhstan to […]...
